messages:
Sara L.: Quick heads-up — I need a mid-quarter reforecast + scope approval for the Q2 OKR 'Adaptive Batching Pilot'. TL;DR: propose narrowing scope to 'pilot with top-5 hosted customers + internal QA' instead of org-wide. Reason: infra kernel regressions + capacity pressure + a large customer asked for SLA-first deliverables. Need decision by EOD Fri so we can update forecasts and comms.

Omar K.: can you paste the proposed KR changes and the expected delta on throughput/latency?

Sara L.: yep -- proposed KRs (draft):
- KR1: Pilot live with top-5 hosted customers and internal QA by end of Q2
- KR2: 20% avg token cost reduction for pilot traffic vs baseline
- KR3: No customer-facing error rate >0.5% during pilot
Accept criteria: rollout runbook, canary plan, rollback policy, documented perf regressions.

Jia W.: quick context: kernel team pushed a micro-optimization that regressed long-seq latency in some configs. We can mitigate with routing to quantized variants but that chews cost. Narrowing scope buys us time to fix kernels without breaking customers.

Omar K.: tradeoff: smaller pilot => less statistically significant cost numbers. We should keep a traffic mirror to collect perf/tok cost across broader org. That keeps data while protecting production.

Sara L.: agreed. Proposal: pilot traffic actual, plus 10% mirror of org traffic to staging infra for metrics only (no customer impact). Mirror = read-only telemetry.

Mike T.: finance check — what's the expected revenue / cost impact if we delay org-wide rollout by one quarter? need rough $ numbers for forecast.

Sara L.: estimate: org-wide rollout would reduce unit cost by 18% company-wide -> ~$420k annualized savings. If delayed one quarter, FY impact ~ -$105k. Pilot-only savings ~ $30k annualized. Will add to spreadsheet.

Mike T.: thanks. Please drop the numbers in the Q2 reforecast tab and tag me. Also include assumptions for token volume and pricing.

Alex (sales): from customer side — one of the top-5 asked explicitly for a latency SLA and jitter targets before they'll enable heavy traffic. Narrow pilot aligns with that ask and helps close renewals. :+1:

Raj H.: AVP/CTO input: I'm okay with scope reduction if we get the following before we launch pilot:
1) Canary plan with traffic ramps and explicit fallback to previous model variant
2) Metric dashboard with per-route latency and token-cost delta
3) A post-mortem template to capture regressions and remediation plan
Otherwise we risk churn.

Sara L.: will prepare canary plan and dashboards. Draft runbook snippet below:
```
Rollout runbook (pilot):
- Day 0: enable pilot for 5 customers at 5% each
- Day 1-2: monitor latency, error rate, cost per token
- If latency > baseline + 25% OR error rate >0.5% -> rollback route to stable variant
- After 72h of stable metrics -> increase to 25% traffic for pilot customers
```

Jia W.: can we add automated fallback based on quantile-latency checks? I can wire a circuit that flips routing when p95 > threshold. Need ~2 days to implement tests.

Omar K.: also want a perf-signature test in CI that simulates top-5 customer payloads. If we see delta > 10% in CI, block canary.

Sara L.: good call — adding both to acceptance criteria.

okrs-bot: Draft OKR updated: 'Adaptive Batching Pilot' scoped to top-5 hosted customers. (link to OKR: https://okrs.redwood.internal/okr/3124)

Mike T.: FYI finance is ok with $105k hit for the quarter given renewed confidence from sales on the SLA ask. We need a short note for execs explaining why delay improves retention risk.

Alex (sales): I can draft a 2-sentence customer comms note on SLA timeline + pilot scope for renewals. Will coordinate with Sara.

Raj H.: final decision: Approve scope reduction with the listed pre-launch gating criteria (canary, dashboard, fallback, CI perf test). Action owners: Sara (PM) to update OKR and comms, Jia (Eng) to own fallback + CI test, Omar (Eng Dir) to own canary plan + infra mirror, Mike (Finance) to update reforecast, Alex (sales) to draft customer comms.

Sara L.: noted. I'll update the OKR doc, tag owners, and aim to have the gating artifacts in the shared folder by Thurs EOD. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

Omar K.: will sync with kernel team today re: timeline for regression fix — filing a short follow-up in eng-runtime.

Sara L.: final ask — can leadership sign off on the plan by Friday? Raj H.: signing off now (thumbsup).

okrs-bot: OKR status changed to 'scope-modified (pending final docs)'.
